name: Ship Straight Assist
description: When you spam-click in ship mode, the ship holds a straight line instead of bouncing. v1.1: pause-menu GUI, presets, soft ramp, hard flatten, cooldown, practice-only and quick toggle.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the assist on or off.

click-count.name: Clicks to trigger
click-count.description: How many fast clicks activate the assist.

click-window.name: Click window (seconds)
click-window.description: The clicks must happen within this time.

release-time.name: Stop delay (seconds)
release-time.description: Assist turns off this long after your last click.

strength.name: Assist strength
strength.description: 1.0 = perfectly flat line, lower = gentler help.

cooldown.name: Cooldown (seconds)
cooldown.description: After the assist turns off, it cannot trigger again for this long. 0 = no cooldown.

ramp-time.name: Soft ramp (seconds)
ramp-time.description: Eases the assist in over this time instead of snapping on. 0 = instant (same as v1.0).

hard-flatten.name: Hard flatten
hard-flatten.description: Holds the ship perfectly level while the assist is on (ignores strength).

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only run the assist in Practice Mode.

affect-player2.name: Affect player 2
affect-player2.description: Also assist the second ship in dual mode.

quick-button.name: Quick toggle button
quick-button.description: Adds a small SA button on screen to switch the assist on or off mid-level (dim = off, hidden while paused).

pause-button-scale.name: Pause button size
pause-button-scale.description: Size of the Assist button on the pause screen.
